notablePrerequisites:
"Time Lord" or "Rogue" chosen with Reflections of Littjara.
Venser and Great Whale have at least one takeover counter on them.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {U}{B}.
You have enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable.
description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {U}{B}.
Cast The Master either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {U}{B} and commander tax, if applicable.
Reflections of Littjara triggers, copying the Master spell.
Resolve the copy of the Master spell, choosing to having the Master token enter the battlefield as a copy of Great Whale.
When the token Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the original Master spell, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Venser.
When the nontoken Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
